Preserve all accepted requirements, existing observed-selector guards, actual per-product navigation, writes and cleanup. The current implementation cannot pass review for bounded extraction: all four t_select_*_facts extract tasks receive an entire snapshot OBJECT and return multiple fields; NONE declares each. Saying "deterministically" or "each record" in an objective does not activate independent processing. Do not execute this shape against potentially large snapshots.
For each such extraction, bind a named collection input directly to field(snapshot, pages), and explicitly declare each:{input:<that collection name>,output:<the sole array result field>}. The resultType is an object containing exactly that array result field; each item is one page's compact facts (possibly nested arrays). Shared inputs contain only small necessary context, never the entire snapshot or duplicate raw content. Process EVERY page, preserve source order, grouping, observed selectors/URLs and relevant facts. Global interpretation consumes only these compact per-page results and necessary context. Selection/ranking across pages remains global and the product maximum remains 10. Empty per-page facts mean checked absence, not skipped data. Do not invent extraction status labels; use explicit interpretation for classifications.
Read captureTruncated, manifestTruncated, URL and recordCount directly from the authoritative Browser output through existing field bindings, outside learned extraction. Check both completeness flags BEFORE mapping/interpretation with existing requires guards. Incomplete acquisition must fail explicitly, with existing cleanup, not produce a successful empty workbook. Keep real workbook writing for valid observations. Do not drop requested work.
Replace t_cookie_gate's differently shaped whole landingFacts exports with explicitly matching typed ports for the compact page facts, URL and necessary metadata. Both alternatives project their own values with the same types/nullability/requiredness. Keep existing valid product/report interfaces and the exact observed nullable-selector conditional guard. No guessed selectors, widened contracts, raised limits, permission changes or new public inputs.
